verification_questions.question: Does a reaction write in one tab (own/incoming, add/remove/rollback, DM and group) refresh another tab's open thread without reload, via a two-module-instance unit test over a simulated BroadcastChannel?
Is the refresh scoped to the announced thread (other cached threads not re-read, their listeners silent), and are unscoped notices ignored?
Does a refresh arriving mid-removal never revive the removed badge, and do the existing badge-revival / cache-first tests (api.test.ts, api-property.test.ts) still pass?

Are storage failures injected on every touched step (set rejects / commits-then-rejects, refresh read fails, delMany rejects, post throws) with stored state as truth and no rejection from the receiver?
Is docs/behavior/reactions-and-emoji.md (and groups.md multi-tab line) updated, unit suite + tsc green, Stryker (concurrency 1) survivors on changed lines killed or justified?
